video.title: Run AI Models Locally for FREE | What is Docker Model Runner? #docker

transcript.text: You can now run AI models locally for
free using Docker Model Runner. So what
is Docker Model Runner? Docker Model
Runner is a tool that allows you to run
AI models like large language models
simplifies the process by allowing you
to pull, run, and manage these models
using the same Docker commands that you
already know. Using Docker Model Runner,
you can now test and develop AI
external APIs or expensive GPU setups.
